topic: Christmas Eve: a film with レン
title_jp: イブの{映画|えいが}と{次|つぎ}の{約束|やくそく}
context: Thursday 24 December, Christmas Eve: アルちゃん and レン's first real date. After 『{素晴らしき哉|すばらしきかな}、{人生|じんせい}！』 at レン's cinema, they walk to {長野駅|ながのえき} in the snow and plan the next date.
scene: Christmas Eve. The film is over and snow is falling in {長野|ながの}. Walking to the station with レン, you plan your next date.

phrases.en: When shall we do the next one?
phrases.note: 〜にする = decide on. {何|なに}にする？ = what will you have?

phrases.jp: {年明け|としあけ|after New Year|3}の3{日|か}はどう？
phrases.en: How about the 3rd, after New Year?
phrases.note: 〜はどう？ = suggesting a date or plan.

phrases.jp: じゃあ、{決まり|きまり|it's settled|3}ね。
phrases.note: Closes a plan. Also: {決|き}まりだね！

phrases.jp: {彼|かれ}は{優しい|やさしい}ばかりか、{料理|りょうり}まで{上手|じょうず}なんだ。
phrases.en: He's not only kind, he's even a good cook.
phrases.note: ばかりか… まで: the second thing is the bigger surprise.

phrases.jp: {都合|つごう|convenience, schedule|3}のいい{日|ひ}を{教えて|おしえて}ください。
phrases.en: Please tell me which days suit you.
phrases.note: {都合|つごう}がいい / {悪|わる}い = (a time) suits / doesn't suit you.

dialogue_setting: A street of shops near {長野駅|ながのえき}, about 8 p.m. on Christmas Eve. Light snow; the two of you walk side by side, not too close.

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: {字幕|じまく|subtitles|3}、{速かった|はやかった}でしょ。{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}だった？
dialogue.en: The subtitles were fast, weren't they? Were you OK?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {英語|えいご}だから{平気|へいき|fine, no problem|4}。{主人公|しゅじんこう|main character|3}が{最後|さいご}に{笑う|わらう}{場面|ばめん|scene|3}、{泣けた|なけた|to be moved to tears|3}よ。
dialogue.en: It's in English, so no problem. The scene where the hero smiles at the end made me cry.

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: {僕|ぼく}も、{何回|なんかい}{見て|みて}も{泣ける|なける|to be moved to tears|3}んだ。…ねえ、{雪山|ゆきやま}を{歩く|あるく}{約束|やくそく}、{覚えてる|おぼえてる|to remember|4}？
dialogue.en: Me too: it gets me every time. …Hey, do you remember our promise to walk in the snowy mountains?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: もちろん！でも{年末|ねんまつ|end of the year|3}は{大掃除|おおそうじ}ばかりか、{そば打ち|そばうち|making soba by hand|2}まで{手伝う|てつだう}{予定|よてい}なんだ。
dialogue.en: Of course! But at the end of the year I'm helping with the big clean, and even soba-making.

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: じゃあ、{年明け|としあけ|after New Year|3}の3{日|か}はどう？{戸隠|とがくし}なら、スノーシューで{歩ける|あるける}よ。
dialogue.en: Then how about the 3rd, after New Year? At {戸隠|とがくし} we can walk in snowshoes.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: いいね、{決まり|きまり|it's settled|3}！{今日|きょう}は{映画|えいが}ばかりか、{次|つぎ}の{約束|やくそく}までできちゃった。
dialogue.en: Great, it's settled! Today I didn't just get a film, I even got our next date.

listening.intro: At {長野駅|ながのえき}, the speakers have news about your train home.
listening.title: {駅|えき}の{放送|ほうそう|announcement|3}

lines.jp: お{客様|きゃくさま}にお{知らせ|しらせ}いたします。{本日|ほんじつ}は{雪|ゆき}のため、
lines.en: Announcement to all passengers. Today, because of snow,

lines.jp: {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}{方面|ほうめん|direction (of)|3}の{電車|でんしゃ}は、{約|やく}15{分|ふん}{遅れて|おくれて}おります。
lines.en: trains for {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} are running about 15 minutes late.

listening.question: {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}{行き|いき}の{電車|でんしゃ}は、どうなっていますか。
options: 雪で15分ぐらい遅れている
雪で50分ぐらい遅れている
事故で15分ぐらい遅れている
listening.explain: {雪|ゆき}のため = because of snow; {約|やく}15{分|ふん}{遅|おく}れて = about 15 minutes late.

grammar.form: noun: + ばかりか ({映画|えいが}ばかりか) · verb / い-adj: plain + ばかりか ({泣|な}けるばかりか, {優|やさ}しいばかりか) · な-adj: + なばかりか ({上手|じょうず}なばかりか)
grammar.explanation: Like だけでなく, but the second thing is bigger or more surprising, so it usually takes まで, さえ or も. It sounds a bit written; in chat it adds a playful, dramatic touch. Don't use it for requests or invitations.

examples.jp: {健太|けんた}は{遅刻|ちこく|being late|3}したばかりか、{財布|さいふ}まで{忘れた|わすれた}。
examples.en: {健太|けんた} wasn't just late, he even forgot his wallet.

examples.jp: この{店|みせ}は{安い|やすい}ばかりか、{量|りょう}も{多い|おおい}。
examples.en: This place isn't only cheap, the portions are big too.

quiz.question: {雪|ゆき}で、バス＿＿{電車|でんしゃ}まで{止まった|とまった}。
quiz.en: Because of the snow, not only the buses but even the trains stopped.
quiz.explain: Noun + ばかりか, then まで for the bigger surprise.

quiz_more.question: レンは{写真|しゃしん}が{上手|じょうず}＿＿、{自分|じぶん}で{現像|げんぞう|developing (film)|2}までする。
quiz_more.en: レン isn't just good at photos, he even develops them himself.
quiz_more.explain: な-adjectives keep な before ばかりか.

quiz_more.question: この{映画|えいが}は{子ども|こども}＿＿、{大人|おとな}も{泣ける|なける}。
quiz_more.en: This film moves not only children but adults too.
quiz_more.explain: ばかりか adds the second, bigger group: adults too.

kanji.where: On the hand-painted board outside レン's cinema, under 『{素晴らしき哉|すばらしきかな}、{人生|じんせい}！』.
kanji.breakdown: {上映中|じょうえいちゅう}: {上映|じょうえい} screening (上 up + 映 project onto a screen) + 中 during → the film is showing now.
kanji.related: {上映時間|じょうえいじかん} = running time; {映画館|えいがかん} = cinema.

tip.title: A Japanese Christmas
tip.body: In Japan Christmas is a fun season, not a religious one, for most people. Families eat fried chicken and a strawberry Christmas cake, often ordered weeks ahead, while Christmas Eve is the couples' night: lights, dinner, a film. It's a {文化|ぶんか} thing that surprises many visitors.

challenge.prompt: On the platform, レン: 「3{日|か}、{何時|なんじ}にどこで{会う|あう}？」 Suggest meeting at {長野駅|ながのえき} at 9 in the morning.
challenge.model_answer: じゃあ、{朝|あさ}9{時|じ}に{長野駅|ながのえき}で{会おう|あおう}か。
challenge.explanation: Time + に, place + で, then the volitional {会|あ}おう ('let's meet'). Adding か makes it a soft suggestion: 'shall we?'. Casual, right with レン now.
challenge.hint: time に, place で, volitional + か

vocab.note: {字幕版|じまくばん} = subtitled version; {吹|ふ}き{替|か}え = dubbed.
Casual {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}. {平気|へいき}な{顔|かお} = a calm face.
Films, novels, games. Not {主人|しゅじん} (husband, shop owner).
{場|ば} place + {面|めん} face. Also シーン.
{泣|な}ける{映画|えいが} = a tearjerker. Like a potential of {泣|な}く.
{覚|おぼ}えてる？ = do you remember? {覚|おぼ}える{単語|たんご} = words to learn.
{年末年始|ねんまつねんし} = the New Year holidays.

vocab.en: the start of the new year
vocab.note: {年明|としあ}けに = early in January, after the holidays.
{都合|つごう}がいい / {悪|わる}い. Polite way to ask when someone is free.

kanji_study.parts: 氵 water radical + 立 stand → water running down the face of someone standing there: cry.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 位 (rank): 位 has 亻 person on the left, 泣 has 氵 water.

kanji_study.parts: 亻 person + 匕 a person turned upside down → someone turning into something else: change.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 花 (flower): 花 is 化 with 艹 grass on top.

{駅前|えきまえ}のイルミネーション、きれいだね。
